original_test_intent: Visually verify that the BIOS Main-page System Date is correct under the platform's approved RTC, timezone and date-format policy.
original_method: Record synchronized OS, RTC and BMC time context, enter BIOS Setup, capture the date field without editing it, normalize the sources under the approved policy, and exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must observe the BIOS System Date field and ensure it was not edited; OS `date` reflects OS timezone/NTP policy and is only a reference.
safety_requirements: Avoid testing across midnight unless boundary handling is defined.
Do not infer BIOS date solely from OS local date.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare/read OS, RTC, timezone/NTP and BMC timestamp context when later approved.
Normalize supplied reference and UI evidence.
Flag differences without claiming UI action or verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the time policy and observation window.
Capture the BIOS date without editing.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Valid as a current OS-time reference but not equivalent to the BIOS UI or hardware RTC semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the exact `date` command and supplement it with read-only RTC/timezone state; keep the BIOS UI primary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact date command, Main-page date check and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a timestamped BIOS date alongside OS local/UTC, RTC and BMC sources, documenting normalization and midnight-boundary treatment.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/BIOS and project time policy.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record OS, timezone/NTP, BIOS and BMC versions/state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible source normalization without modifying the date.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NTP-adjusted OS time may differ from firmware RTC representation.

project_override_considerations: The project defines UTC/local RTC and allowed rollover behavior; missing policy delays execution but does not permanently BLOCK the library case.
expected_evidence: Timestamped BIOS System Date and format
Unchanged setting, normal boot and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets System Date. RTC/timezone policy is missing execution context, while the DeepSeek equivalence is a prior-review overreach.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The date observation is clear; policy and console availability govern readiness.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains OS date only as cross-check and rejects command-only YES.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on manual UI core and RTC/timezone controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds rollover-aware evidence and explicitly separates readiness and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents timezone, NTP or midnight rollover from creating a false comparison while preserving the original read-only UI check.
independent_technical_reasoning: The case validates the firmware-rendered date, whose relation to OS time depends on RTC policy. Since the UI must be visually observed, the core remains MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not change time, re-enter Setup or repeat a reboot automatically after mismatch; preserve synchronized evidence and stop.
